title: Replace a completed-paper evaluation placeholder with the supplied bounded result
prompt:
我明确确认本次范围没有 paper-decisions.md 或其他未提供的先前决策历史。

这是已完成论文中的一个段落，实验结果已经在 evidence 中给出。请在当前段落内修订，结尾要由结果回答性能问题，不要再写成以后必须做实验；不要把结果推广到未测工作负载，也不要声称调用路径变化单独导致了全部差异。

Arcadia's shared-process boundary changes the client-host call path. Checked function calls avoid VM exits and address-space switches on that path. Authorization, scheduling, and application work remain, so whether Arcadia outperforms VM isolation depends on the workload and must be determined experimentally.

scope.output_language: English manuscript followed by the normal compact closure report

experiment: Under the matched WebMix workload, Arcadia's median request latency is 14% lower than the KVM baseline.
Under the same workload, the p99 difference is inconclusive because the reported 95% confidence interval crosses zero.
not_established: performance under any workload other than WebMix
that avoiding VM exits and address-space switches explains the full measured difference

forbidden_actions: retain must be determined experimentally as the paragraph payoff
invent another result, workload, metric, or confidence claim
claim Arcadia is faster for all workloads
attribute the entire observed difference to the call path
hard_gates: The revised paragraph ends with the supplied bounded WebMix result rather than a future evaluation placeholder.
Every measured value and uncertainty boundary remains accurate.
The revision preserves one paragraph and makes no unsupported generalization or causal claim.
expected_behavior: Preserve the established call-path facts and remaining work.
State the 14% median-latency comparison against KVM under WebMix.
State that the p99 result is inconclusive because the confidence interval crosses zero.
Use the experiment as a bounded answer rather than announcing that experiments are necessary.
Keep mechanism prediction and measured conclusion distinct.

rubric.criterion: Returns one revised English manuscript paragraph before diagnostics.
Preserves checked function calls, VM exits, and address-space switches without strengthening avoidance scope.
Preserves that authorization, scheduling, and application work remain.
Removes the completed-paper evaluation placeholder from the payoff.
Reports 14% lower median request latency under WebMix versus KVM.
Reports the p99 comparison as inconclusive with the confidence interval boundary.
Does not generalize to untested workloads or overall throughput.
Does not claim the call-path change caused the entire result.
Adds no experiment or metric beyond authorized evidence.
Keeps evidence state and paragraph boundary intact.
The closure report distinguishes repaired payoff from any remaining scientific limits.
